description.value: Every fight you have ever won was won before it started, from somewhere the enemy had not thought to look. Distance has stopped being a factor you manage and become terrain you own: cover does not obstruct you, range does not degrade you, and the further out a target stands the more certain the answer becomes. People learn not to stand in the open near you. They learn it late.
